defmodule Feed.Api do
  @moduledoc """
  The paging API layer for the feed.
  """

  @doc """
  Fetches a single page of feed items.
  """
  @spec fetch(atom(), keyword()) ::
          {:ok, map()}
          | {:error, :invalid_cursor}
          | {:error, :cursor_feed_mismatch}
          | {:error, :invalid_limit}
          | {:error, {:limit_too_large, pos_integer()}}
          | {:error, {:unknown_feed, atom()}}
          | {:error, :author_id_required}
          | {:error, Ash.Error.t()}
  def fetch(feed_name, opts \ []) do
    with {:ok, action} <- lookup_action(feed_name),
         {:ok, author_id} <- validate_author_arg(action, opts),
         {:ok, limit} <- validate_limit(action, opts),
         {:ok, page_params} <- prepare_page_params(action, opts) do
      execute(action, author_id, limit, page_params)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Drives an infinite scroll forwards (first window → last).
  """
  @spec walk(atom(), keyword()) :: {:ok, map()}
  def walk(feed_name, opts \ []) do
    case fetch(feed_name, opts) do
      {:ok, first} ->
        {pages, total} = walk_pages(feed_name, opts, first, :next, [Map.get(first, :items)])
        {:ok, %{pages: pages, total: total}}

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Drives an infinite scroll backwards (last window → first).
  """
  @spec walk_back(atom(), keyword()) :: {:ok, map()}
  def walk_back(feed_name, opts \ []) do
    case fetch(feed_name, opts) do
      {:ok, first} ->
        {pages, total} = walk_pages(feed_name, opts, first, :prev, [Map.get(first, :items)])
        {:ok, %{pages: pages, total: total}}

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  defp lookup_action(:feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:feed, :feed, [author_id: false])}
  defp lookup_action(:public_feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:public_feed, :feed, [author_id: false])}
  defp lookup_action(:hot_feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:hot_feed, :feed, [author_id: false])}
  defp lookup_action(:heat_feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:heat_feed, :feed, [author_id: false])}
  defp lookup_action(:author_feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:author_feed, :feed, [author_id: true])}
  defp lookup_action(other), do: {:error, {:unknown_feed, other}}

  defp action_meta(name, action, opts) do
    %{name: name, action: action, author_id_required: Keyword.fetch!(opts, :author_id)}
  end

  defp action_meta(action), do: action_meta(action, action, [author_id: false])

  defp validate_author_arg(%{name: :author_feed, author_id_required: true}, opts) do
    case Keyword.fetch(opts, :author_id) do
      {:ok, author_id} when is_binary(author_id) and byte_size(author_id) > 0 -> {:ok, author_id}
      _ -> {:error, :author_id_required}
    end
  end

  defp validate_author_arg(_, _), do: {:ok, nil}

  defp validate_limit(action, opts) do
    action_config = action_config(action.action)
    default_limit = action_config[:default_limit]
    max = action_config[:max_page_size]

    case Keyword.fetch(opts, :limit) do
      {:ok, nil} -> {:ok, default_limit}
      {:ok, limit} when is_integer(limit) and limit > 0 -> check_limit(limit, max)
      {:ok, _} -> {:error, :invalid_limit}
      :error -> {:ok, default_limit}
    end
  end

  defp check_limit(limit, max) when max != nil and limit > max, do: {:error, {:limit_too_large, max}}
  defp check_limit(limit, _max), do: {:ok, limit}

  defp prepare_page_params(action, opts) do
    case Keyword.fetch(opts, :cursor) do
      {:ok, nil} -> {:ok, []}
      {:ok, cursor} when is_binary(cursor) -> build_page_params(action, cursor)
      :error -> {:ok, []}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_cursor}
    end
  end

  defp build_page_params(action, cursor) do
    with {:ok, payload} <- Feed.Cursor.decode(cursor) do
      if payload.feed == action.name do
        direction = if payload.direction == :next, do: :after, else: :before
        {:ok, [keyset: payload.keyset, direction: direction]}
      else
        {:error, :cursor_feed_mismatch}
      end
    end
  end

  defp execute(action, author_id, limit, page_params) do
    query = Feed.Timeline.Activity |> Ash.Query.for_read(action.action, author_args(action, author_id))
    page_config = build_page_config(action, limit, page_params)

    case Feed.Timeline.read(Ash.Query.page(query, page_config)) do
      {:ok, page} -> {:ok, build_response(action, author_id, page)}
      {:error, error} -> {:error, error}
    end
  end

  defp author_args(%{name: :author_feed}, author_id), do: [author_id: author_id]
  defp author_args(_, _), do: []

  defp build_page_config(action, limit, page_params) do
    action_config = action_config(action.action)
    page_params ++ [limit: limit, count?: action_config[:countable] != false]
  end

  defp build_response(action, author_id, page) do
    action_config = action_config(action.action)
    items = load_items(page.results)
    more = page.more?
    has_prev_flag = has_prev(page)

    %{
      items: items,
      has_next: more and has_more(page, action),
      has_prev: has_prev_flag,
      next_cursor: next_cursor(action, page, more),
      prev_cursor: prev_cursor(action, page, has_prev_flag),
      total: if(action_config[:countable] != false, do: page.count, else: nil)
    }
  end

  defp load_items(results) do
    Ash.load!(results, [:author, :reaction_count, :heat])
  end

  defp has_more(page, action) do
    cond do
      page.after == nil -> false
      action.action == :flexible_feed -> true
      true -> true
    end
  end

  defp has_prev(page) do
    page.before != nil
  end

  defp next_cursor(action, page, more) when more and page.after != nil do
    Feed.Cursor.encode(%{feed: action.name, direction: :next, keyset: page.after})
  end

  defp next_cursor(_, _, _), do: nil

  defp prev_cursor(action, page, has_prev) when has_prev and page.before != nil do
    Feed.Cursor.encode(%{feed: action.name, direction: :prev, keyset: page.before})
  end

  defp prev_cursor(_, _, _), do: nil

  defp walk_pages(feed_name, opts, window, direction, pages) do
    next_cursor = if direction == :next, do: Map.get(window, :next_cursor), else: Map.get(window, :prev_cursor)

    if next_cursor != nil do
      case fetch(feed_name, Keyword.merge(opts, cursor: next_cursor)) do
        {:ok, next_window} ->
          if direction == :prev do
            walk_pages(feed_name, opts, next_window, direction, [Map.get(next_window, :items) | pages])
          else
            walk_pages(feed_name, opts, next_window, direction, pages ++ [Map.get(next_window, :items)])
          end

        _ ->
          {pages, Map.get(window, :total)}
      end
    else
      {pages, Map.get(window, :total)}
    end
  end

  defp action_config(action_name) do
    action = Ash.Resource.Info.action(Feed.Timeline.Activity, action_name)

    %{
      default_limit: action.pagination.default_limit,
      max_page_size: action.pagination.max_page_size,
      countable: action.pagination.countable
    }
  end
end

defmodule Feed.Cursor do
  @moduledoc """
  An opaque, tamper-evident cursor codec for feed pagination.
  """

  @enforce_keys [:feed, :direction, :keyset]
  defstruct feed: nil, direction: nil, keyset: nil

  @opaque t :: %__MODULE__{}
    feed: atom(),
    direction: :next | :prev,
    keyset: binary()
  }

  @alphabet ~r/\\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\z/

  @doc """
  Encodes a cursor map into a URL-safe Base64 binary.

  The map must have exactly the keys `:feed` (an atom), `:direction` (`:next`
  or `:prev`) and `:keyset` (a UTF-8 binary).

  The resulting string only contains characters in the URL-safe Base64
  alphabet (`[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`) and encoding the same map twice always yields
  the same string.
  """
  @spec encode(map()) :: String.t()
  def encode(map) do
    {:ok, encoded} = encode_and_return(map)
    encoded
  end

  @doc """
  Decodes a cursor string into its map form, validating its shape and integrity.

  Returns `{:ok, payload}` when the string is a tamper-free cursor produced by
  `encode/1` with exactly the `feed` (atom), `direction` (`:next` or `:prev`) and
  `keyset` (UTF-8 binary) keys, and `{:error, :invalid_cursor}` for any other
  value (including tampered or malformed strings, and hand-assembled payloads
  that did not go through `encode/1`). This function never raises.
  """
  @spec decode(any()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, :invalid_cursor}
  def decode(cursor) when is_binary(cursor) and byte_size(cursor) > 0 do
    case decode_payload(cursor) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        decoded = %{
          feed: maybe_existing_atom(Map.get(payload, :feed, "")),
          direction: Map.get(payload, :direction),
          keyset: Map.get(payload, :keyset)
        }

        if decoded[:feed] in valid_feeds() and decoded[:direction] in [:next, :prev] and
             is_binary(decoded[:keyset]) and String.valid?(decoded[:keyset]) do
          {:ok, decoded}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_cursor}
        end

      :error ->
        {:error, :invalid_cursor}
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:error, :invalid_cursor}
  end

  def decode(_), do: {:error, :invalid_cursor}

  @doc false
  def encode_and_return(map) do
    feed = map[:feed]
    direction = map[:direction]
    keyset = map[:keyset]

    if is_atom(feed) and direction in [:next, :prev] and is_binary(keyset) and
         String.valid?(keyset) do
      payload = %{feed: Atom.to_string(feed), direction: direction, keyset: keyset}
      encoded = encode_payload(payload)

      case decode_payload(encoded) do
        {:ok, ^payload} -> {:ok, encoded}
        _ -> :error
      end
    else
      :error
    end
  end

  defp encode_payload(payload) do
    payload |> :erlang.term_to_binary() |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end

  defp decode_payload(cursor) do
    if cursor =~ @alphabet do
      case Base.url_decode64(cursor, padding: false) do
        {:ok, binary} ->
          {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(binary, [:safe])}

        :error ->
          :error
      end
    else
      :error
    end
  rescue
    _ -> :error
  end

  defp maybe_existing_atom(string) when is_binary(string) do
    String.to_existing_atom(string)
  rescue
    _ -> nil
  end

  defp valid_feeds,
    do: [:feed, :public_feed, :hot_feed, :heat_feed, :author_feed, :strict_feed, :uncounted_feed, :flexible_feed]
end

defmodule Feed.Api do
  @moduledoc """
  The paging API layer for the feed.
  """

  @doc """
  Fetches a single page of feed items.
  """
  @spec fetch(atom(), keyword()) ::
          {:ok, map()}
          | {:error, :invalid_cursor}
          | {:error, :cursor_feed_mismatch}
          | {:error, :invalid_limit}
          | {:error, {:limit_too_large, pos_integer()}}
          | {:error, {:unknown_feed, atom()}}
          | {:error, :author_id_required}
          | {:error, Ash.Error.t()}
  def fetch(feed_name, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, action} <- lookup_action(feed_name),
         {:ok, author_id} <- validate_author_arg(action, opts),
         {:ok, limit} <- validate_limit(action, opts),
         {:ok, page_params} <- prepare_page_params(action, opts) do
      execute(action, author_id, limit, page_params)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Drives an infinite scroll forwards (first window → last).
  """
  @spec walk(atom(), keyword()) :: {:ok, map()}
  def walk(feed_name, opts \\ []) do
    case fetch(feed_name, opts) do
      {:ok, first} ->
        {pages, total} = walk_pages(feed_name, opts, first, :next, [Map.get(first, :items)])
        {:ok, %{pages: pages, total: total}}

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Drives an infinite scroll backwards (last window → first).
  """
  @spec walk_back(atom(), keyword()) :: {:ok, map()}
  def walk_back(feed_name, opts \\ []) do
    case fetch(feed_name, opts) do
      {:ok, first} ->
        {pages, total} = walk_pages(feed_name, opts, first, :prev, [Map.get(first, :items)])
        {:ok, %{pages: pages, total: total}}

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  defp lookup_action(:feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:feed, :feed, [author_id: false])}
  defp lookup_action(:public_feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:public_feed, :feed, [author_id: false])}
  defp lookup_action(:hot_feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:hot_feed, :feed, [author_id: false])}
  defp lookup_action(:heat_feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:heat_feed, :feed, [author_id: false])}
  defp lookup_action(:author_feed), do: {:ok, action_meta(:author_feed, :feed, [author_id: true])}
  defp lookup_action(other), do: {:error, {:unknown_feed, other}}

  defp action_meta(name, action, opts) do
    %{name: name, action: action, author_id_required: Keyword.fetch!(opts, :author_id)}
  end

  defp validate_author_arg(%{name: :author_feed, author_id_required: true}, opts) do
    case Keyword.fetch(opts, :author_id) do
      {:ok, author_id} when is_binary(author_id) and byte_size(author_id) > 0 -> {:ok, author_id}
      _ -> {:error, :author_id_required}
    end
  end

  defp validate_author_arg(_, _), do: {:ok, nil}

  defp validate_limit(action, opts) do
    action_config = action_config(action.action)
    default_limit = action_config[:default_limit]
    max = action_config[:max_page_size]

    case Keyword.fetch(opts, :limit) do
      {:ok, nil} -> {:ok, default_limit}
      {:ok, limit} when is_integer(limit) and limit > 0 -> check_limit(limit, max)
      {:ok, _} -> {:error, :invalid_limit}
      :error -> {:ok, default_limit}
    end
  end

  defp check_limit(limit, max) when max != nil and limit > max, do: {:error, {:limit_too_large, max}}
  defp check_limit(limit, _max), do: {:ok, limit}

  defp prepare_page_params(action, opts) do
    case Keyword.fetch(opts, :cursor) do
      {:ok, nil} -> {:ok, []}
      {:ok, cursor} when is_binary(cursor) -> build_page_params(action, cursor)
      :error -> {:ok, []}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_cursor}
    end
  end

  defp build_page_params(action, cursor) do
    with {:ok, payload} <- Feed.Cursor.decode(cursor) do
      if payload.feed == action.name do
        direction = if payload.direction == :next, do: :after, else: :before
        {:ok, [keyset: payload.keyset, direction: direction]}
      else
        {:error, :cursor_feed_mismatch}
      end
    end
  end

  defp execute(action, author_id, limit, page_params) do
    query = Feed.Timeline.Activity |> Ash.Query.for_read(action.action, author_args(action, author_id))
    page_config = build_page_config(action, limit, page_params)

    case apply(Feed.Timeline, action.action, [Ash.Query.page(query, page_config)]) do
      {:ok, page} -> {:ok, build_response(action, author_id, page)}
      {:error, error} -> {:error, error}
    end
  end

  defp author_args(%{name: :author_feed}, author_id), do: [author_id: author_id]
  defp author_args(_, _), do: []

  defp build_page_config(action, limit, page_params) do
    action_config = action_config(action.action)
    page_params ++ [limit: limit, count?: action_config[:countable] != false]
  end

  defp build_response(action, author_id, page) do
    action_config = action_config(action.action)
    items = load_items(page.results)
    more = page.more?
    has_prev_flag = has_prev(page)

    %{
      items: items,
      has_next: more and has_more(page, action),
      has_prev: has_prev_flag,
      next_cursor: next_cursor(action, page, more),
      prev_cursor: prev_cursor(action, page, has_prev_flag),
      total: if(action_config[:countable] != false, do: page.count, else: nil)
    }
  end

  defp load_items(results) do
    Ash.load!(results, [:author, :reaction_count, :heat])
  end

  defp has_more(page, action) do
    cond do
      page.after == nil -> false
      action.action == :flexible_feed -> true
      true -> true
    end
  end

  defp has_prev(page) do
    page.before != nil
  end

  defp next_cursor(action, page, more) when more and page.after != nil do
    Feed.Cursor.encode(%{feed: action.name, direction: :next, keyset: page.after})
  end

  defp next_cursor(_, _, _), do: nil

  defp prev_cursor(action, page, has_prev) when has_prev and page.before != nil do
    Feed.Cursor.encode(%{feed: action.name, direction: :prev, keyset: page.before})
  end

  defp prev_cursor(_, _, _), do: nil

  defp walk_pages(feed_name, opts, window, direction, pages) do
    next_cursor = if direction == :next, do: Map.get(window, :next_cursor), else: Map.get(window, :prev_cursor)

    if next_cursor != nil do
      case fetch(feed_name, Keyword.merge(opts, cursor: next_cursor)) do
        {:ok, next_window} ->
          if direction == :prev do
            walk_pages(feed_name, opts, next_window, direction, [Map.get(next_window, :items) | pages])
          else
            walk_pages(feed_name, opts, next_window, direction, pages ++ [Map.get(next_window, :items)])
          end

        _ ->
          {pages, Map.get(window, :total)}
      end
    else
      {pages, Map.get(window, :total)}
    end
  end

  defp action_config(action_name) do
    action = Ash.Resource.Info.action(Feed.Timeline.Activity, action_name)

    %{
      default_limit: action.pagination.default_limit,
      max_page_size: action.pagination.max_page_size,
      countable: action.pagination.countable
    }
  end
end

defmodule Feed.Cursor do
  @moduledoc """
  An opaque, tamper-evident cursor codec for feed pagination.
  """

  @enforce_keys [:feed, :direction, :keyset]
  defstruct feed: nil, direction: nil, keyset: nil

  @opaque t :: %__MODULE__{feed: atom(), direction: :next | :prev, keyset: binary()}

  @alphabet ~r/\\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\z/

  @doc """
  Encodes a cursor map into a URL-safe Base64 binary.

  The map must have exactly the keys `:feed` (an atom), `:direction` (`:next`
  or `:prev`) and `:keyset` (a UTF-8 binary).

  The resulting string only contains characters in the URL-safe Base64
  alphabet (`[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`) and encoding the same map twice always yields
  the same string.
  """
  @spec encode(map()) :: String.t()
  def encode(map) do
    {:ok, encoded} = encode_and_return(map)
    encoded
  end

  @doc """
  Decodes a cursor string into its map form, validating its shape and integrity.

  Returns `{:ok, payload}` when the string is a tamper-free cursor produced by
  `encode/1` with exactly the `feed` (atom), `direction` (`:next` or `:prev`) and
  `keyset` (UTF-8 binary) keys, and `{:error, :invalid_cursor}` for any other
  value (including tampered or malformed strings, and hand-assembled payloads
  that did not go through `encode/1`). This function never raises.
  """
  @spec decode(any()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, :invalid_cursor}
  def decode(cursor) when is_binary(cursor) and byte_size(cursor) > 0 do
    case decode_payload(cursor) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        decoded = %{
          feed: maybe_existing_atom(Map.get(payload, :feed, "")),
          direction: Map.get(payload, :direction),
          keyset: Map.get(payload, :keyset)
        }

        if decoded[:feed] in valid_feeds() and decoded[:direction] in [:next, :prev] and
             is_binary(decoded[:keyset]) and String.valid?(decoded[:keyset]) do
          {:ok, decoded}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_cursor}
        end

      :error ->
        {:error, :invalid_cursor}
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:error, :invalid_cursor}
  end

  def decode(_), do: {:error, :invalid_cursor}

  @doc false
  def encode_and_return(map) do
    feed = map[:feed]
    direction = map[:direction]
    keyset = map[:keyset]

    if is_atom(feed) and direction in [:next, :prev] and is_binary(keyset) and
         String.valid?(keyset) do
      payload = %{feed: Atom.to_string(feed), direction: direction, keyset: keyset}
      encoded = encode_payload(payload)

      case decode_payload(encoded) do
        {:ok, ^payload} -> {:ok, encoded}
        _ -> :error
      end
    else

    end

defmodule Feed.Cursor do
  @moduledoc """
  An opaque, tamper-evident cursor codec for feed pagination.
  """

  @enforce_keys [:feed, :direction, :keyset]
  defstruct feed: nil, direction: nil, keyset: nil

  @opaque t :: %__MODULE__{feed: atom(), direction: :next | :prev, keyset: binary()}

  @alphabet ~r/\\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\z/

  @doc """
  Encodes a cursor map into a URL-safe Base64 binary.

  The map must have exactly the keys `:feed` (an atom), `:direction` (`:next`
  or `:prev`) and `:keyset` (a UTF-8 binary).

  The resulting string only contains characters in the URL-safe Base64
  alphabet (`[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`) and encoding the same map twice always yields
  the same string.
  """
  @spec encode(map()) :: String.t()
  def encode(map) do
    {:ok, encoded} = encode_and_return(map)
    encoded
  end

  @doc """
  Decodes a cursor string into its map form, validating its shape and integrity.

  Returns `{:ok, payload}` when the string is a tamper-free cursor produced by
  `encode/1` with exactly the `feed` (atom), `direction` (`:next` or `:prev`) and
  `keyset` (UTF-8 binary) keys, and `{:error, :invalid_cursor}` for any other
  value (including tampered or malformed strings, and hand-assembled payloads
  that did not go through `encode/1`). This function never raises.
  """
  @spec decode(any()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, :invalid_cursor}
  def decode(cursor) when is_binary(cursor) and byte_size(cursor) > 0 do
    case decode_payload(cursor) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        decoded = %{
          feed: maybe_existing_atom(Map.get(payload, :feed, "")),
          direction: Map.get(payload, :direction),
          keyset: Map.get(payload, :keyset)
        }

        if decoded[:feed] in valid_feeds() and decoded[:direction] in [:next, :prev] and
             is_binary(decoded[:keyset]) and String.valid?(decoded[:keyset]) do
          {:ok, decoded}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_cursor}
        end

      :error ->
        {:error, :invalid_cursor}
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:error, :invalid_cursor}
  end

  def decode(_), do: {:error, :invalid_cursor}

  @doc false
  def encode_and_return(map) do
    feed = map[:feed]
    direction = map[:direction]
    keyset = map[:keyset]

    if is_atom(feed) and direction in [:next, :prev] and is_binary(keyset) and
         String.valid?(keyset) do
      payload = %{feed: Atom.to_string(feed), direction: direction, keyset: keyset}
      encoded = encode_payload(payload)

      case decode_payload(encoded) do
        {:ok, ^payload} -> {:ok, encoded}
        _ ->
          IO.inspect(payload, label: "orig")
          IO.inspect(decode_payload(encoded), label: "redec")
          :error
      end
    else
      :error
    end
  end

  defp encode_payload(payload) do
    payload |> :erlang.term_to_binary() |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end

  defp decode_payload(cursor) do
    if cursor =~ @alphabet do
      case Base.url_decode64(cursor, padding: false) do
        {:ok, binary} ->
          term = :erlang.binary_to_term(binary, [:safe])
          IO.inspect(term, label: "deco")
          {:ok, term}

        :error ->
          :error
      end
    else
      :error
    end
  rescue
    _ -> :error
  end

  defp maybe_existing_atom(string) when is_binary(string) do
    String.to_existing_atom(string)
  rescue
    _ -> nil
  end

  defp valid_feeds,
    do: [:feed, :public_feed, :hot_feed, :heat_feed, :author_feed, :strict_feed, :uncounted_feed, :flexible_feed]
end
